info.name: LLM Chat
info.summary: Chat with LLMs directly from your browser — the server never sees your prompts
info.description:
A chat interface for large language models where **your browser talks directly to the LLM backend**. Nextcloud acts only as configuration storage and archive target — it is never a proxy and never sees prompts or responses.
Because the requests originate in the browser, `localhost` resolves from the *user's* machine. Your Nextcloud can live in a datacenter and still talk to an Ollama instance running on your laptop.
Features:
* Multiple connections (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter) with encrypted API key storage * Multiple profiles per connection (model, system prompt, temperature, max tokens) * Streaming responses with abort support * Chat history in IndexedDB — local to the browser, by design * Archive chats as Markdown files into your Nextcloud files * Profile export/import as JSON (never contains secrets)
**Note:** API keys are stored encrypted on the server but are necessarily delivered to the browser, since that is where the request is made. Each user only ever sees their own key.
